sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)
Captioned petition is by claimant questioning the negligence and quantum determined by Tribunal in MVC No.942/2012.

2. Facts leading to case are as under:
Deceased is the mother of appellant herein, who died in a road traffic accident dated 15.04.2012.
Mother of NC: 2024:KHC-K:9775 appellant herein was traveling in a goods vehicle and she died in the above said accident, having sustained grievous injuries.
Appellant being son, filed a claim petition seeking compensation on the ground that he was totally dependant on his mother and his mother was earning Rs.6,000/- p.m. by doing Bidari Butti work.

Tribunal in absence of income proof assessed the income of deceased notionally at Rs.3,000/- and after deducting 50%,
awarded a sum of Rs.2,52,000/- under the head of loss of dependency.
Tribunal in all awarded a sum of Rs.3,32,000/-.
Tribunal also attributed negligence in the ratio of 70:30.
70% negligence is fastened on goods vehicle bearing No.MH- 13/AX-2339.
Finding on Negligence:

This Court in MFA.No.202567/2019 considering the arguments advanced by the counsel appearing for the claimants and the counsel appearing for both the Insurance Companies has after meticulous examination of the material on record and on an Sanjay S/O Baburao vs Mohammed Hanif on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109400494/
2 elaborate discussion held that both the drivers of the truck were negligent and NC:
2024:KHC-K:9775 therefore, attributed negligence in the ratio of 50:50.

entities.text: Sanjay S/O Baburao vs Mohammed Hanif
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly,
negligence is attributed in the ratio of 50:50 on the drivers of both the vehicles involved in the accident.

Further more, since the truck bearing No. MH- 13-AX-2339 was used in violation of the policy conditions permitting 30 passengers to travel in the goods vehicle, Respondent No.3, who is the owner of the truck bearing No.
MH-13-AX-2339 is liable to deposit 50% of the compensation awarded.

Respondent No.2/Insurance Company who is the insurer of the goods vehicle bearing No.
KA.36/A.2976 which was illegally parked is jointly and severally liable along with respondent No.1 to deposit 50% of the compensation awarded.

On quantum:
3.
In absence of income proof, this Court is inclined to place reliance on income chart prepared by Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.
Accident is of the year 2012 and hence, income works out to Rs.6,500/-.
But, claimant himself has admitted income of deceased at NC: 2024:KHC-K:9775 Rs.6,000/-.
Such being the case, income pleaded in the claim petition is accepted.

By adding 25%
towards future prospects, income works out to Rs.7,500/-.
In the case on hand, claimant's mother is dead and therefore, this Court is not inclined to deduct 50%.
If, 1/3rd is deducted, income is assessed at Rs.5,000/-.
By applying multiplier 14, income under the head of loss of dependency works out to Rs.8,40,000/-.
4. Under conventional heads Rs.70,000/- is awarded.
Additionally, 20% escalation is awarded i.e.Rs.14,000/- as per principles laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of National Insurance Co. Ltd., Vs. Pranay Sethi1.

entities.text: National Insurance Co. Ltd., Vs. Pranay Sethi1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Total compensation awarded by this Court works out to Rs.9,24,000/-
as against Rs.3,32,000/-
5.

For the foregoing reasons this Court passes the following order:
(2017) 16 SCC 680 NC: 2024:KHC-K:9775 ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The impugned judgment and award dated 19.12.2018 passed by the Tribunal in MVC.No.942/2012 is hereby modified.

(iii) Appellant is entitled for enhanced compensation a Rs.5,92,000/- with interest at the rate of 6%,
from the date of petition, till realization of entire compensation.
(iv) The negligence is fixed in the ratio of 50:50 on the drivers of both the vehicles.
Respondents 1 and 2 are jointly and severally held liable to deposit 50% of compensation awarded and balance 50%
shall be paid by respondent No.3/Owner of the offending vehicle i.e. MH-13-AX-2339.
